messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
I don’t have a tool that pulls up new documentary titles directly, but I can point you toward some widely‑recognized films that focus on climate change and global warming:

| Title | Release Year | Director(s) | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|-------------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former Vice President Al Gore’s presentation on climate science and his personal journey to raise awareness. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights ongoing climate activism. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Fisher Stevens | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to document the impacts of climate change and explores solutions. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | Various | A short, fact‑based overview produced by the BBC, summarizing key scientific findings. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conners | A documentary featuring voices from the environmental movement, exploring humanity’s relationship with Earth. |

If you’re looking for something more recent or a specific angle—like the economic impacts, adaptation strategies, or indigenous perspectives—I can try to narrow it down further. Let me know what aspect interests you most!
